pages.text: The $(item)Otherworld Goggles$() give the wearer permanent $(#AA00AA)Third Eye$(), allowing to view even blocks hidden from those partaking of $(l:getting_started/demons_dream)Demon's Dream$(/l).$(br2)This elegantly solves the general issue of summoners being in a drugged haze, causing $()

The Goggles will, however, not give the ability to harvest otherworld materials.$(br) That means when wearing goggles, an $(l:getting_started/infused_pickaxe)Infused Pick$(/l), or even better, an $(l:getting_started/iesnium_pickaxe)Iesnium Pick$(/l) needs to be$(br) used to break blocks in order to obtain their $()

Otherworld Goggles make use of a $(#AA00AA)Foliot$() bound into the lenses.$(br) The Foliot shares its ability to view higher planes with the wearer,$(br) thus allowing them to see Otherworld materials.$(br)

pages.title: Crafting Lenses
pages.text: Summoning a spirit into the lenses used to craft goggles is one of the$(br) first of the more complex rituals apprentice summoners usually attempt,$(br) showing that their skills are progressing beyond the basics.$(br)
